Forex.pk, Pakistan's top currency rates portal provides you upto date open market currency rates of Pakistan. Currency exchange rates in Pakistan open market are not quite same as inter bank specially dollar rate. Here you can find USD to PKR , EURO to PKR , SAR to PKR and all other currency rate against PKR. In Pakistan Banks generally charge a higher exchange rate on the currency. We timely update currency rate on our website specialy USD to PKR to give our visitors good experience. Here you will find open market currency rates history, graphs, charts and a wide range of information to help you explore the Pakistan Currency Open Market.
